caveats: Sea cells = region grid cells with finite SST on all 92 target days. Baseline pools include the +-5 day windows around 1992-01-01..2002-12-31, i.e. dates 1991-12-27..2003-01-05. Threshold = 90th percentile via numpy method='hazen' (MATLAB default per task), climatology = mean, both NaN-ignoring; day 60 set to mean of days 59 and 61 before a 31-day centred circular moving mean over 366 days. Per-cell MHWs: >=5 consecutive days with SST >= threshold, runs separated by <=2 non-hot days joined; restricted to 2021-06-01..2021-08-31. Regional event = maximal run of days where at least one sea cell is in a per-cell MHW.
